== Biography ==
John was born before 1810. He is the son of [[Glasgow-1460|John Glasgow]] and [[Bryce-1075|Jean Bryce]]. 
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1460]] is assessed at 87% (probable). The held FamilySearch church-index account places John Glasgow, 10 April 1810, in John Glasgow and Jean Bryce’s child sequence. The 1841 Hume’s Close household supports that adult family, while identification with the 1783 Bathgate child remains strongly circumstantial.

Selected father-profile identity and paternal relationship; maternal identity is separate.

Next useful test: Find John/Jean’s marriage or John’s death identifying his earlier family.
